Security.evtx.title: Windows Security Event Log
Security.evtx.role: Primary forensic repository for authentication, user rights assignment, account management, audit policy changes, and object access.
Security.evtx.retention: Fixed maximum size (typically 20MB to 1GB in Enterprise). Wrap-around overwrite policy.

System.evtx.title: Windows System Event Log
System.evtx.role: Contains events logged by Windows system components, service control manager, hardware changes, kernel drivers, and system startup/shutdown.

Application.evtx.title: Windows Application Event Log
Application.evtx.role: Logs software errors, application crashes (WerFault / Event 1000), MSI installer installations (Event 11707), and third-party utility telemetry.

Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational.evt.title: Microsoft Sysmon Operational Telemetry Log
Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational.evt.role: Premier endpoint telemetry sensor providing detailed process lineage, network sockets, raw disk access, process memory injection, and pipe/DNS activity.
Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational.evt.retention: Typically configured to 64MB - 512MB by SOC engineering.

Operational.evtx.title: Microsoft Sysmon Operational Telemetry Log
Operational.evtx.role: Premier endpoint telemetry sensor providing detailed process lineage, network sockets, raw disk access, process memory injection, and pipe/DNS activity.
Operational.evtx.retention: Typically configured to 64MB - 512MB by SOC engineering.

Sysmon.evtx.title: Microsoft Sysmon Operational Telemetry Log
Sysmon.evtx.role: Premier endpoint telemetry sensor providing detailed process lineage, network sockets, raw disk access, process memory injection, and pipe/DNS activity.
Sysmon.evtx.retention: Typically configured to 64MB - 512MB by SOC engineering.

Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational.title: Microsoft PowerShell Operational Log
Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational.role: Deep PowerShell execution log capturing de-obfuscated script blocks (EID 4104), interactive command invocation (EID 4103), and AMSI bypass attempts.
Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational.retention: Default 15MB. Highly recommended to increase to 100MB+.

PowerShell.evtx.title: Microsoft PowerShell Operational Log
PowerShell.evtx.role: Deep PowerShell execution log capturing de-obfuscated script blocks (EID 4104), interactive command invocation (EID 4103), and AMSI bypass attempts.
PowerShell.evtx.retention: Default 15MB. Highly recommended to increase to 100MB+.

Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operatio.title: Windows Task Scheduler Operational Log
Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operatio.role: Monitors creation, execution, and modification of scheduled tasks (primary persistence mechanism for lateral movement and C2 triggers).

Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-Local.title: RDP Local Session Manager Log
Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-Local.role: Records interactive and Remote Desktop (RDP) session connect, disconnect, and reconnect transitions with source IP mapping.

Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Opera.title: Microsoft Defender Antivirus Operational Log
Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Opera.role: Exposes real-time threat detections, quarantined payloads, AMSI blocks, and tamper protection overrides.
